turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! First, watch me do one.
She eats an apple. I look at the first sound of "apple": it is a vowel sound. So I write an.
The rule: we say an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
This is right: I have a pen. This is wrong: I have an pen.

Your turn. Fill the gap:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
